name: Outsourced Shopify Store Management
promise: A monthly team that runs your Shopify store — products, promotions, apps, fixes and speed.
intro: gaa-tha runs outsourced Shopify store management for US and UK brands and for agencies that resell it. A monthly retainer covers product uploads, pricing and promotions, homepage and collection updates, app audits, bug fixes, speed checks and a monthly store report, with a named store manager working US business hours.

glance.bestFor: Brands with a live Shopify store and no in-house developer; agencies reselling store care
glance.timeline: Onboarding audit in the first week, then monthly
glance.model: Monthly retainer scoped to catalog size and change volume
glance.channels: Shopify, Shopify Flow, Matrixify, Klaviyo, GA4

whatIs: Shopify store management is the ongoing operation of a live store: adding products and variants, changing prices and running promotions, updating collections and banners, keeping apps and the theme healthy, fixing bugs and keeping the store fast. Without it, launches wait for a developer and small issues cost sales.

gaa-tha provides it as a monthly retainer with a named store manager, a shared task board and agreed turnaround times. Because design, copy and paid media sit in the same team, a Black Friday sale or a product launch can be set up end to end. Agencies can resell the service under their own brand.
included: Product uploads and edits: SKUs, variants, images, descriptions, tags and metafields
Price changes, compare-at pricing, discount codes and automatic discounts
Homepage, collection, navigation and banner updates on a monthly calendar
Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday and seasonal sale setup
Quarterly app audit to remove unused apps and cut monthly charges
Bug fixes and theme tweaks with tracked turnaround times
Monthly speed and Core Web Vitals check with fixes
Tracking checks for GA4, Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversions
Monthly store report: orders, conversion, speed, errors and tasks completed

steps.title: Store audit
steps.text: We review the theme, apps, tracking, speed and catalog quality, fix urgent issues and agree the monthly scope.

steps.title: Task board
steps.text: Every request goes on a shared board with an owner and due date, in your tool or ours.

steps.title: Monthly calendar
steps.text: Homepage, collections and promotions are planned a month ahead around launches and sale events.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.text: Apps, theme updates, speed and tracking are checked on a schedule and fixed before customers notice.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: A monthly report covers what changed, what broke, conversion trends and next month's recommendations.

deliverables: Shared task board with agreed turnaround times
Monthly homepage, collection and promotion updates
pricing: Monthly retainer custom-quoted on catalog size, change volume and whether design and copy are included; Shopify and app subscriptions are paid by you directly. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.q: What does outsourced Shopify store management include?
faq.a: Product and price updates, promotions, homepage and collection changes, app management, bug fixes, speed checks, tracking checks and a monthly report. gaa-tha runs it as a monthly retainer with a named store manager working US business hours.

Routine changes such as a product upload, price change or banner are typically done within one to two working days, and urgent fixes the same day. Larger work such as a new landing page is scheduled on the task board with a date.

faq.q: Can you prepare our store for Black Friday and holiday sales?
faq.a: Yes. Offer structure, sale collections, banners, countdowns, gift options and free-shipping thresholds are set up and tested ahead of the event and rolled back afterwards.

Yes, at onboarding and every quarter. Unused and overlapping apps are a common cause of slow stores and rising monthly bills, so we list every app, its charge and purpose and remove what is redundant.

faq.q: Can our agency resell this under our brand?
faq.a: Yes. We provide store management white-label: reports and documentation carry your agency's name and we work only through you, under an NDA and non-solicitation agreement.

faq.q: Do we keep ownership of the store?
faq.a: Yes. The store, domain, apps and payment accounts stay in your name. We work through staff or collaborator accounts with only the permissions we need.
